info.title: C11 reader Stops API
info.description:
**Deprecated:** this earlier contract version is still served. Version 2 is the one served now. Its administrator announces 2026-12-31 as the day it stops; it is served until the administrator removes it.

Consumer API `c11-reader-stops-api`, contract version 1, declared by the model release C11 reader model 1.0.2. A read takes the live data of a workspace (`workspace`, default: the deployment's default workspace) or one of its publications (`publication`: an ID or `latest`). Every `GET` answers an `ETag` and `304 Not Modified` to a matching `If-None-Match`.

Named in `RDM-Publication`; a cursor keeps its publication.

get.description: The exposed records the query's terms match, scored by the definition's match rules, best first (score, public type name, name, object ID); with `expect=one`, the single best one. Matching part of a value (contains) needs a term of at least 3 characters; a shorter term matches whole values only. A query whose terms match more than 10,000 records is refused as `400 QUERY_TOO_BROAD`, whatever parameters narrow it. A query holds at most 100 terms. The definition's parameters narrow the scored records without changing their scores.

get.description: The changes this API tells its consumers about (`stop-changed`), in position order: `created`, `updated` naming the watched outputs that changed, `deleted`. Start after a position (`after`: `0`, or a publication's `eventSequence`) and continue by `cursor`, a lasting resume token; `caughtUp` says the events derived so far (`headPosition`) are read. With `payload=full` (default) each event carries its object as get by ID answers it with the same parameters, at the feed position `stateAt`; `payload=identity` leaves it out. A parameter filters as on a list, against live data; an event whose object no longer exists passes every parameter but the type. Events are kept as long as the change feed's entries: an older position is `410 EVENTS_EXPIRED`, naming the publication to re-read.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: The workspace read (default: the deployment's default workspace); named in `RDM-Workspace`.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Keep these events (their keys); several, repeated or comma-separated, are alternatives.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Start after this position: `0`, or a publication's `eventSequence`. Not with `cursor`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `cursor` of a page: continue after it, with the same events and parameters.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: 1–100 with `payload=full` (default 100), 1–1,000 with `payload=identity` (default 500).

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: `full`: each event with its object; `identity`: without it.

parameters.description: Keeps records of these public type names. Several values, repeated or comma-separated (a comma inside a value as `%2C`), are alternatives; text matches ignoring case.
